summary: ICP-based registration app with automatic payment verification. Users pay 1 ICP to a configured wallet address, and the backend canister automatically verifies payment via ICP Ledger integration before unlocking access.
architectural_notes: Payment verification uses inter-canister calls to the ICP Ledger canister to confirm incoming transactions
known_issues: Payment address was not configured, causing 'Zahlungsadresse noch nicht konfiguriert' error — now being addressed with Ledger integration

existing_features.title: Update the PaymentGate frontend component to automatically poll or trigger `verifyAndActivate()` after the user copies the payment address or clicks a 'I have paid' / 'Check Payment' button. Display a loading state while verification is in progress, a success message when the account is activated, and a clear error message (e.g., 'No payment found yet — please wait a moment and try again') if no qualifying payment is detected. The existing 30-second activation status polling (useActivationQueries) should continue so the gate dismisses automatically once activation is confirmed.
Add a `verifyAndActivate` method to the frontend actor interface and expose a corresponding React Query mutation in useActivationQueries.ts so components can call it without direct actor access.

new_feature_requests.summary: Automatic ICP Ledger integration: backend canister queries ICP Ledger to verify payment receipt and auto-unlock user account. ICP receiving address: eadaef90a0208bf42e25d15b9d99b767e72ed66ed1fab5b66a7799bfe88283c0

Integrate the ICP Ledger canister in the backend to automatically verify incoming ICP payments. The backend actor must query the ICP Ledger (canister ID: ryjl3-tyaaa-aaaaa-aaaba-cai) to check whether a payment of at least 1 ICP has been received at the configured receiving address (eadaef90a0208bf42e25d15b9d99b767e72ed66ed1fab5b66a7799bfe88283c0). Store this address as the default/fallback if none has been set by the admin. Expose a public function `verifyAndActivate()` that any authenticated user can call: it checks the Ledger for a transfer of ≥ 1 ICP to that address where the memo or source can be associated with the calling principal, and if found, marks the user as activated.
